It commonly affects individuals with a family history of allergies or respiratory issues, particularly children and adults with compromised immune systems. Ephedra sinica has been studied for its potential to alleviate asthma symptoms by reducing bronchial spasms and improving airflow. Flavonoids contribute to the plant's anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, further supporting respiratory health.
